revision_note: 2026-10-12 (INT-08): read model for the Due Process screen. Lists households under NOTICE_OF_INELIGIBILITY in the caller's jurisdiction. notice_date is the stored APPROVED_GRADUATION instant and notice_expiry_date is +15 elapsed days (calculateAppealDeadline), so the countdown matches POST /appeals/docket. Appeal details come from the latest hash-verified APPEAL_FILED block for the current notice. Items use the client's DueProcessNoticeItem shape. notice_date and notice_expiry_date are null when no approved notice record exists.
